# Second Line AI

> Second Line AI is a Baton Rouge, Louisiana-based HVAC revenue recovery partner for residential contractors. Its managed Revenue Recovery Desk helps HVAC companies capture more value from inbound demand during missed calls, overflow, after-hours, weekends, and slow follow-up.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://secondlineai.com/): Revenue Recovery Desk overview, Marie live demo, calculator, qualification, and FAQ.
- [How to book the audit](https://secondlineai.com/audit): Free 17-minute Revenue Recovery Audit for HVAC owners and operators.
- [Meet Marie](https://secondlineai.com/marie): Live call experience with Marie, the HVAC intake specialist.
- [Founding Partners](https://secondlineai.com/founding-partners): High-touch early partner opportunity for Louisiana HVAC contractors.
- [About](https://secondlineai.com/about): Second Line AI’s Louisiana focus and operating philosophy.
- [Privacy](https://secondlineai.com/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://secondlineai.com/terms): Terms and conditions.

## Positioning notes

Second Line AI is not positioned as a generic AI receptionist or a replacement for an HVAC office team. Marie is an intake specialist inside the broader managed Revenue Recovery Desk. Marie does not diagnose HVAC equipment, invent pricing, or make unauthorized technical promises. Revenue estimates on the site are illustrative only and are not guarantees.
